provenance: Standards: Spaarke baseline positions (not tailored) v0.1.0 · Skill: nda-review v0.1.1-mvp

edits.comment: Please confirm the effective date: the draft shows 9 July 2017.
Extended the written-summary window for oral disclosures to 30 days, our standard fallback.

edits.insert: , or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential given the nature of the information and the circumstances of its disclosure
edits.comment: Added a reasonable-person limb so that a failure to mark does not forfeit protection.

edits.after: is independently developed by the Recipient
edits.insert: without use of or reference to the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information
edits.comment: Independent development must be without use of the other party's information.

edits.insert: Representatives must be bound by obligations of confidentiality at least as protective as this Agreement, and each party is responsible for any breach of this Agreement by its Representatives.
edits.comment: Added the binding-obligation requirement and responsibility for Representatives' breaches.

edits.find: The Recipient may use anonymized or aggregated data derived from Confidential Information to improve its products and services.
edits.comment: Deleted: permits use of data derived from the other party's information for the recipient's own products. Escalate if the counterparty insists.

edits.insert: , provided that, where legally permitted, the Recipient gives the Disclosing Party prompt written notice, reasonably cooperates at the Disclosing Party’s expense in seeking a protective order, and discloses only the portion legally required
edits.comment: Added notice, cooperation and a limit to what is legally required.

edits.insert: within thirty (30) days and, on request, certify the return or destruction in writing; routine backups and copies required by law may be retained subject to this Agreement
edits.comment: Added a 30-day deadline and certification, with the usual backup exception.

edits.find: Nothing in this Agreement restricts either party from using any ideas, concepts or know-how retained in the unaided memory of its personnel.
edits.comment: Escalate: residuals clause lets either party use information retained in memory. Deleted; senior approval needed to accept any version.

edits.find: terminate upon expiration of this Agreement
edits.replace: survive for three (3) years after the date of each disclosure, and with respect to trade secrets for as long as the information remains a trade secret under applicable law
edits.comment: Obligations survived only for the one-year agreement term. Now three years from disclosure, and indefinitely for trade secrets.

summary.revision: 3 years from disclosure; trade secrets protected

edits.insert: with whom it had contact in connection with the Purpose; general solicitations not targeted at such employees do not breach this Section

edits.comment: Reduced to 12 months, limited to employees met through the discussions, with a general-solicitation exception.

edits.find: without the consent of the other party.
edits.replace: without the other party’s prior written consent, except to a successor to all or substantially all of the relevant business that assumes this Agreement in writing.

edits.comment: Assignment now needs consent, except to a successor of the relevant business.
Escalate: exclusive venue in Texas, where neither party is based. Proposed Delaware law with non-exclusive Delaware courts; confirm the business preference.

summary.issue: Exclusive venue where neither party is based
